build_command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build (vite-ssg build)
compat_notes: Pre-patch anybuild plan: node-static, vite, dist, pnpm 10.30.2. Also has a Dockerfile (nginx).
policy: An open, unanswered Hostinger deploy-button PR (#562) exists. #561 was closed by its author in a mass close and re-opened as #562, so it is not a maintainer refusal. No CONTRIBUTING.
reason: SPA deep route not prerendered: src/pages/hi/[name].vue (/hi/:name) and the [...all] 404 catch-all depend on netlify.toml's '/* /index.html 200' fallback. vite-ssg skips dynamic routes, and Anybuild 0.33's SWS has no index fallback, so a direct load of /hi/<name> would 404. The template's own demo flow (type a name on / and land on /hi/<name>) breaks on reload or a shared link. Not built. | HELD_RUNTIME: needs index.html fallback for history routes; Wasmer runtime SWS 2.32.2 wasm has no fallback (root probe 2026-10-22).
